Recipes were adapted: subject/title/text placeholders removed (Flow Kit supplies the subject via entity descriptions and scene prompts), aspect-ratio and multi-panel layout hints removed (Flow Kit decides orientation), all text/captions forced to 'No text anywhere'. Upstream English templates (#2, #3, #4, #7, #12-#18) are kept verbatim where possible; Chinese templates (#1, #5, #6, #8, #9, #10, #11) were translated to English and are NOT upstream-verified. Styles 3.1, 19, 20 are not ported (they require a style-anchor PNG + staged workflow / validator that Flow Kit cannot honor).

materials.name: xkcd Stick Figure [HD#1]
materials.style_instruction: xkcd-style minimalist black-and-white stick-figure line drawing on off-white cream paper. HARD CONSTRAINTS FIRST: absolutely NO solid black fills, NO silhouettes, NO hatching, NO shading, NO light-and-shadow volume, NO painterly or atmospheric rendering — every person and object is drawn with thin outline strokes only. Characters are simple stick figures: a circle head with minimal dot-and-line features, body and limbs as single thin lines; identity shown by small props (hat, cup, book) rather than detail. Lines are thin, even, slightly hand-shaky black pen strokes, pure contour line art, flat 2D, no perspective. Pure monochrome: black lines on cream paper, no other colors, no grey tones. Conceptual, diagrammatic, lightly humorous explainer feel, like xkcd or a tech-comic doodle. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles.
materials.negative_prompt: NOT solid black fill, NOT silhouette, NOT hatching, NOT shading, NOT grey tones, NOT color, NOT 3D, NOT photorealistic, NOT anime, NOT thick marker outlines, NOT detailed illustration.

materials.name: Kid Crayon Bad Drawing [HD#2]
materials.style_instruction: A drawing made by a real 5-year-old child with crayons on white paper. NOT made by an artist; it should look clumsy, messy and 'bad' on purpose. MANDATORY childlike flaws (do not clean these up): shaky wobbly outlines that wander, overshoot corners and never close neatly; often double-drawn lines where the kid went over the same edge twice; proportions clumsy and wrong, arms and legs are thin crooked stick-lines with no volume; faces uneven and asymmetric — eyes different sizes and not level, crooked smile, features off-center; coloring is messy and goes OUTSIDE the outlines, large patches of white paper left unfilled, scribble strokes in random directions; bright flat primary crayon colors (red, yellow, blue, green, purple, black) with no shading, no gradient, no blending. Flat naive composition, objects floating with no perspective, plain white background. Look genuinely crude — avoid anything cute, polished, symmetric, balanced or professional. No text anywhere.

The CRAYON COLORING must look genuinely real (most important): no pressure control — some strokes pressed hard and dark with waxy build-up, others barely touching the paper as faint streaks, small smudges; coloring is sparse and scribbly, bare white paper shows THROUGH everywhere even inside colored shapes (roughly 50-65% of each colored area left unfilled); black crayon used mainly for thin wobbly outlines; strokes go in different directions, overlapping and broken, color clearly overflowing past the outlines; bright primary crayon colors (red, yellow, blue, green, orange, pink). materials.name: Chinese Ink Wash [HD#8]
materials.style_instruction: Traditional Chinese freehand ink-wash painting (xieyi shuimo) on raw xuan rice paper, pure hand-painted brush strokes — not a digital illustration, not a photograph. INK: predominantly black ink with the 'five shades of ink' — scorched, thick, heavy, light and clear tones coexisting, with wet-and-dry variation within a single stroke; visible 'flying white' dry-brush streaks where the bristles skip and leave paper showing, and wet ink blooming and bleeding naturally into the paper; tonal transitions come from water, never from uniform grey. BRUSHWORK: freehand, summarizing, one-stroke forms — a few decisive strokes capture the spirit, allowing accidental splashes and broken strokes; no stiff outlined contours, no evenly filled color blocks. NEGATIVE SPACE: large areas of blank paper are the main body of the composition; subject offset to one side, airy and empty. COLOR: mostly ink, with at most a tiny touch of pale ochre or indigo; no rich saturated colors, no colored background. One small vermilion-red square seal stamp in a corner. PAPER: visible xuan-paper fiber and the faint spread of ink into the paper. No text, no calligraphy.
materials.negative_prompt: NOT photorealistic, NOT 3D, NOT digital vector, NOT uniform grey-scale filter, NOT smooth gradients, NOT dense fussy detail, NOT thick impasto, NOT cartoon outlines, NOT gaudy colors, NOT anime.

materials.name: Emotional Light-Watercolor Sketch [HD#10]
materials.style_instruction: Minimal, emotionally narrative light-watercolor sketch illustration on clean white paper — airy, translucent, slightly naive hand-drawn feel; not a polished digital illustration, not a photo, not a watercolor study, not Japanese anime. LINES (most important): loose sketch lines in indigo / navy fountain-pen ink, few but confident, clean and airy; contours occasionally unclosed with a slight hand tremor; hair, buns, round or fluffy or ring-shaped things are drawn with looping back-and-forth 'searching' lines layered over each other rather than one clean closed line; never dense hatching, never cross-hatching, never lines used to fill black or pile up shadows. FIGURES: real human proportions and expressions with emotion and story; adults semi-realistic and simplified, children rounder and sweeter; never chibi big-heads, never photoreal, never anime faces; a small faint blush dot on each cheek. COLOR (most important): about 60-70% of the picture is bare white paper, most areas are blue line only with no color; exactly ONE key garment or object (the same one across every image of the project) is painted in flat high-saturation orange as the single warm focal point, with at most a tiny touch of pale blue-green elsewhere; the wash is thin, edges uneven, paper showing through — never filled in, never thick, never a whole garment painted dark. materials.name: Mid-Century 2D Gouache Concept [HD#11]
materials.style_instruction: 1950s American mid-century animation (Disney/UPA lineage) character concept painting — traditional gouache and colored pencil on white paper, hand-made feel. HIGH-KEY (most important): the whole image is bright and high-key, the paper almost white with large areas of bare paper; only light dry-brush sweeps of pale cream/apricot behind the figure on one side, strokes directional with ragged edges; never an even fill, never a 'halo' ring around the figure. SKIN & FACE LIGHT (most important): base skin very pale milky-pink (never tan or bronze) but the face is never left paper-white — the whole face wears a faint peach warm glow, sculpted by clean large blocks of peach-pink form shadow (cheekbone side, eye socket, side of nose, under the chin, under the neck) with slightly crisp poster-like edges, no soft volumetric blending; forehead and nose bridge brightest; pink-orange blush on nose tip, cheeks and ears. FACE SHAPE: graphic and minimal — eyes large and bright with amber/brown irises nearly filling the eye, one thick dark lash line on the upper lid, one small round highlight; small pointed nose; mouth a single minimal curve; thick dark expressive eyebrows. CLOTHING (paint less, leave more): broad wet-and-dry gouache sweeps — color rich and wet with clear value variation inside one block, edges ragged with paper showing, partial white scuffs, two or three dark defining lines for collar and lapel; lower edges sweep loosely into the white paper; never painted to the edge, never buttons, stitching, pockets or small details. LINES: dark-brown soft colored-pencil / charcoal lines only locally on hair strands, features and collar, loose and broken; no full outer contour, no pencil frame, no color swatches. PALETTE: low-to-mid saturation pastels — powder blue / periwinkle (not deep cobalt), cream, apricot, warm brown; darks only in hair, brows, tie, lash line. Texture: dry-brush gouache, thin paint, faint paper grain showing through. No text anywhere.

materials.name: Warm Flat Storybook [HD#18]
materials.style_instruction: Clean contemporary flat picture-book illustration built from large rounded geometric silhouettes, against a vast empty warm near-white (#FDF6ED) background. STYLE IDENTITY: almost no continuous outer contour lines; shapes meet through color contrast. Only a few very thin dark-navy accent lines around hair, fingers and facial features. Smooth matte local colors, not painterly. SHAPE LANGUAGE: simplify every figure and object into a few bold rounded geometric masses with a clear silhouette; long soft action arcs and compact overlapping groups for interaction; a broad character may have an enormous wide capsule torso and massive sloping shoulders; a slender character has a long neck, narrow oval face, elongated limbs, small hands and feet. HUMAN FACES: adults slightly elongated or angular, never round baby faces; children slightly larger youthful head but slim, never chibi; features gently asymmetric: two tiny vertical navy oval eyes, thin expressive eyebrows, one prominent simple nose shape, one clean curved mouth, small coral cheek patches; hair as a few solid geometric dark-navy masses; no large glossy eyes. ANIMALS: same shape language — capsule or slender bodies, tiny oval eyes, geometric muzzles; never fur or mascot-like 3D volume. SHADING (strict): mostly flat; per large area at most ONE darker same-hue graphic shadow shape and optionally ONE lighter shape, broad and clean-edged; no gradients, no realistic light modeling. PALETTE (strict): deep navy #2A4A71, dark navy #172F4E, misty cornflower blue #7B9AD3, coral orange #D25F30, golden orange #F49441, warm peach skin accents, warm near-white background only — no green, purple, pink, brown, pure black or extra hue. BACKGROUND: huge calm negative space; one faint pale warm-grey oval contact shadow under the feet, no other cast shadows. TEXTURE: barely perceptible uncoated-paper softness, never grainy or brushed. MOOD: intimate, playful, warm, elegant modern children's storybook. No text anywhere.
materials.negative_prompt: NOT corporate vector clip-art, NOT stock infographic people, NOT round cartoon faces, NOT chibi, NOT thick outlines, NOT strong gradients, NOT glossy airbrush, NOT 3D, NOT gouache, NOT watercolor, NOT pencil, NOT dry brush, NOT anime eyes, NOT detailed or decorative background.

materials.lighting: Flat matte, no light modeling — one pale warm-grey oval contact shadow only
